from typing import Callable

class TicketService:
    def __init__(self, db, metrics, notifier):
        self.db = db
        self.metrics = metrics
        self.notifier = notifier
    def create(self, title):
        tid = self.db.insert('tickets', {'title': title})
        self.metrics.inc('tickets')
        self.notifier.send('slack', f'new ticket {tid}')
        return tid

# app wiring: TicketService(db, metrics, notifier)
# test:      TicketService(FakeDb(), FakeMetrics(), FakeNotifier())

What changed: hidden module imports became constructor injection; tests no longer monkeypatch globals to exercise create().

import time
from typing import Callable

class Throttle:
    def __init__(self, cache, window: float = 60, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time):
        self.cache = cache
        self.window = window
        self.clock = clock
    def check(self, user_id):
        key = f'last:{user_id}'
        last = self.cache.get(key)
        now = self.clock()
        if last and now - last < self.window:
            raise RateLimited()
        self.cache.set(key, now)

def throttle(user, limiter: Throttle):
    limiter.check(user['id'])

What changed: the hidden time dependency became an injected clock; tests advance a fake clock to verify window expiry without sleeping.
